lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to buy a linen loincloth and wear it, but not to let it touch water.
Jeremiah goes at once to Euphrates and hides the loincloth there in a crevice of the rocks.
Many days later Jeremiah digs up the loincloth, and it is ruined and of no use at all.
The LORD says that in the same way He will ruin the walls of Judah and Jerusalem.
The LORD will fill everyone in the land with drunkenness, including kings and priests, and will show them no mercy.
